name: Hasuna
bio: A wanton hedonist and flagrant rule-breaker might seem an odd choice to be a guide for the most devout Lightseeker clerics, but Hasuna knows her patch of the Voidscar like no-one else. They're stuck with her. But, even as she delights in teasing them, she never stops fighting to protect them.
